title: Bishkek State University named after K. Karasaev announces admission to the basic PhD doctoral program in the following scientific and educational programs (specialties):

blocks.text: Bishkek State University named after K. Karasaev announces admission to the basic PhD doctoral program in the following scientific and educational programs (specialties):
- Philological Education, Linguistics
Psychology
- Management, Economics
Pedagogy
Main information about the programs:
Form and duration of study: Training in PhD programs is carried out full-time; the standard duration of study is 3 years, and the total workload is 180 ECTS credits.

Final examination: The program concludes with the preparation and public defense of a qualification work — a PhD dissertation, based on the results of which the academic degree of Doctor of Philosophy (Doctor of Philosophy / PhD) is awarded.
The entrance examinations will be conducted in the form of an interview in 2 rounds:
Round 1 — September 9, 2026
Round 2 — October 9, 2026
Document Checklist for PhD Doctoral Programs
Application addressed to the Rector of BSU, specifying the chosen field of study.
A brief justification of the preliminary dissertation topic.
A copy of a language proficiency certificate demonstrating the level of Russian, Kyrgyz, or English (mandatory for foreign citizens).
List of scientific works (if available).
6 photos measuring 3 x 4 cm;
Personal data sheet and a document confirming employment history (for individuals with work experience).
Сopy of passport and higher education/Master's diploma (for citizens of the Kyrgyz Republic).
Translated (into Kyrgyz/Russian) and notarized copy of passport and higher education/Master's diploma (for foreign citizens).

A certificate from the authorized state body in the field of education and science of the Kyrgyz Republic confirming the level and content of educational documents issued by foreign educational institutions.
Medical insurance policy (for foreign citizens).
Acceptance of documents will take place from July 13 to October 10, 2026, at the following address: Bishkek, BSU named after K. Karasaev, 307 (admissions committee).
